text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing,
Rose Kingdom and I stopped
by the lounge of a hotel she frequented,
whereupon—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My, my... Rose-san and her Trainer.
What a curious coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I exchanged brief greetings with Dream
Journey and Orfevre,
who happened to be seated right next to
us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We took our seats
and opened up the menus for the time
being.
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, which tea would you car...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us see...
Shall we go with Assam today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering the balance of her meal plan
for today,
a dairy snack is recommended.
Furthermore,
factoring in the pairing with black tea—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I propose milk financiers,
butter-rich scones, and baked cheesecake
as our candidates.
choice_data_list: Perhaps you would care to have it ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
And let us have the cheesecake as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you only want coffee?
choice_data_list: Yes, that is more than sufficient.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I checked over the new items on the menu.
If there was anything ideal for her nutritional
snacks,
I wanted to take note of it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
How about some Panama Geisha
for a refill, at least?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For working as hard as you always do,
you deserve a little indulgence.
Don't be shy.
choice_data_list: No, I prefer it this way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............I... see...
So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――*Chuckle.*

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me...
It was simply so identical.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their table was in a similar state to
ours.
Only in front of Orfevre sat a lavish
afternoon tea set――

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Sister.
A scone for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, understood.
Both clotted cream and jam, right?
How does that Keemun tea taste to you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Mm, I find this quite to my liking.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see, I am glad to hear that.
The brand we use here has quite a fine
reputation.
I will order some of the tea leaves for
you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Barely taking a moment for their own tea
break,
spending all their time fussing over
Orfevre-senpai...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—It is almost as though they are behaving
toward me just like the Trainer does...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Do you find it curious, Rose?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, I thought that perhaps you,
Trainer,
might understand how I feel...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(............ It is the same.
The Trainer's expression just now,
and Journey-senpai's...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Are you...
truly content with 'that'?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—That's right.
He was always this kind of person.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—Right.
She has always been this kind of person.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Always striving and giving their all for
my sake...
While possessing a reserved nature that
shies from the limelight,
they also hold an unyielding will.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The resolve to "support me."
It is precisely because you are who you are—
———)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(As a retainer to walk beside me on the path
I tread for the Rose clan—
I can entrust myself to you.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――I feel I now grasp what sort of accessory
would truly befit you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...No.
It seems I was overthinking things.
Forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You may do as you see fit.
choice_data_list: In that case, I will go ask the st...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
You truly are humble to a fault,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However...
I find such sentiment to be truly
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the new menu,
I wished to confirm the precise nutritional
breakdown.
That was why I needed to speak with the
staff.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, go right ahead.
I shall relax here in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――Heh. You truly are a tireless worker,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I must duly repay that devotion...)
